import { useId, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Marquee } from '@/components/marquee'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export interface FeatureChip {
  /** Short name of the feature. */
  title: string
  /** One line of detail. */
  description?: string
  /** Decorative icon. */
  icon?: ReactNode
}

export interface FeaturesMarqueeProps {
  /** Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Copy under the headline. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Features split over the rows, filled in turn. */
  features: FeatureChip[]
  /** How many rows of moving chips. */
  rows?: 1 | 2 | 3
  /** Seconds for one full loop of a row. */
  duration?: number
  /** Pause a row while the pointer or focus is on it. */
  pauseOnHover?: boolean
  /** Element for the headline. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  /** Element for the root. */
  as?: ElementType
  /** Stops the motion and shows the chips still. */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

function Chip({ feature }: { feature: FeatureChip }) {
  return (
    <li className="flex w-64 shrink-0 items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 text-card-foreground">
      {feature.icon != null && (
        <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary [&_svg]:size-4.5">
          {feature.icon}
        </span>
      )}
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{feature.title}</p>
        {feature.description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{feature.description}</p>}
      </div>
    </li>
  )
}

/** A headline over rows of feature chips that drift in alternating directions. Built on Marquee. */
export function FeaturesMarquee({
  title,
  description,
  features,
  rows = 2,
  duration = 40,
  pauseOnHover = true,
  titleAs: Title = 'h2',
  as: Tag = 'section',
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: FeaturesMarqueeProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const lanes = Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, r) => features.filter((_, i) => i % rows === r))

  return (
    <Tag aria-labelledby={id} className={cn('@container w-full', className)}>
      <div className="mx-auto mb-10 flex max-w-2xl flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <Title id={id} className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground @xl:text-4xl">
          {title}
        </Title>
        {description != null && <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,transparent,black_12%,black_88%,transparent)]">
        {lanes.map((lane, r) => (
          <Marquee
            key={r}
            reverse={r % 2 === 1}
            pauseOnHover={pauseOnHover}
            duration={duration + r * 6}
            repeat={Math.max(3, Math.ceil(8 / Math.max(1, lane.length)))}
            gap="1rem"
            disabled={disabled}
          >
            <ul className="flex shrink-0 gap-4">
              {lane.map((f) => (
                <Chip key={f.title} feature={f} />
              ))}
            </ul>
          </Marquee>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Tag>
  )
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { FeaturesMarquee } from '@/components/features-marquee'

const Icon = ({ d }: { d: string }): ReactNode => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d={d} />
  </svg>
)

const features = [
  { title: 'Version history', description: 'Restore any earlier state.', icon: <Icon d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 3-6.7L3 8m0-5v5h5m4-1v5l3 2" /> },
  { title: 'Granular roles', description: 'Control who sees what.', icon: <Icon d="M12 11a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8zM4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0" /> },
  { title: 'Webhooks', description: 'Push events anywhere.', icon: <Icon d="M10 14a5 5 0 0 0 7 0l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7-7l-1 1M14 10a5 5 0 0 0-7 0l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7 7l1-1" /> },
  { title: 'Dark mode', description: 'Follows the system theme.', icon: <Icon d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.8z" /> },
  { title: 'Keyboard first', description: 'Every action has a shortcut.', icon: <Icon d="M3 7h18v10H3zM7 11h.01M11 11h.01M15 11h.01M8 14h8" /> },
  { title: 'Offline mode', description: 'Keep working without a signal.', icon: <Icon d="M2 8.8a15 15 0 0 1 20 0M5 12.5a10 10 0 0 1 14 0M8.5 16a5 5 0 0 1 7 0M12 20h.01" /> },
  { title: 'Audit logs', description: 'A record of every change.', icon: <Icon d="M9 12h6M9 16h6M7 3h7l5 5v13H7zM14 3v5h5" /> },
  { title: 'CSV export', description: 'Take your data with you.', icon: <Icon d="M12 3v12m0 0-4-4m4 4 4-4M4 21h16" /> },
]

export default function FeaturesMarqueeDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl">
      <FeaturesMarquee
        title="And a long list of small things"
        description="The details that make a product feel finished."
        features={features}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
